verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses entirely on software tools (FIDO2 management apps, TOTP toolset, PIV drivers) and never describes Token2's physical hardware lineup, connector types (USB-C/USB-A), or form factors (keychain, nano). No mention of product SKUs, dimensions, or port types is present, so there's no basis to confirm coverage of power-user form-factor variety. Missing for 10: hardware product listings, connector-type specs, form-factor descriptions (nano/keychain), any comparison chart of models.
